Key features: pink-purple discoloration on seed coats, blotches of varying size, some seeds heavily stained, some with just spots near the hilum.

Top candidate: **Purple_Seed_Stain** — matches perfectly with "pink to purple spots ranging from specks to large blotches covering the entire surface."

The reference image confirms Purple_Seed_Stain: seeds showing identical pink-to-purple blotchy discoloration on yellow/tan seed coats, exactly matching the test image pattern. The test image seeds show the same partial-to-full purple staining characteristic of this disease.
